name: Omnifin Dark
author: omnifin
description: A refined, near-black theme. Oxanium type, ice-cyan accent, rounded posters and a configurable highlight colour.

vars.name: Accent Colour
vars.description: Highlight colour for buttons, focus rings, progress bars and the selected library.

vars.name: Corner Radius
vars.description: Rounding on posters, cards, buttons and dialogs. Use CSS units, e.g. 0.75em or 0px for square corners.

vars.name: UI Scale
vars.description: Multiplier for the whole interface. 1 is stock size, 1.15 is noticeably larger, 0.9 is denser.

name: Omnifin Vaporwave
author: omnifin
description: Neon on deep purple. Drifting sunset gradient, CRT scanlines, a perspective grid horizon and chromatic fringing on titles.

vars.name: Primary Neon
vars.description: The cyan half of the palette. Used for focus, links and active tabs.

vars.name: Secondary Neon
vars.description: The hot pink half of the palette. Used for the selected library, gradients and glow.

vars.name: Glow Strength
vars.description: Intensity of every neon glow and chromatic fringe. 0 turns them all off, 1 is default, 2 is loud.

vars.name: Scanline Opacity
vars.description: Opacity of the CRT scanline overlay. 0 disables it.

vars.name: Grid Opacity
vars.description: Opacity of the perspective grid horizon on the background. 0 disables it.

vars.name: Background Drift (seconds)
vars.description: How long one sweep of the background gradient takes. Higher is slower and cheaper.
